name_zh: 阿尔法罗/厄瓜多尔/自由/世俗/铁路/教育/刺杀/埃洛伊/自由
description_zh: 埃洛伊·阿尔法罗 (1843-1895) 厄瓜多尔总统 (1895) 军事独裁者，实施世俗教育、铁路建设、民族解放，推翻垄断统治，建立自由共和国，因激进改革和个人魅力被暗杀，成为厄瓜多尔自由象征。
description_en: Eloy Alfaro (1843-1895) Ecuadorian President (1895) military dictator, implemented secular education, railway construction, national liberation, overthrew monopoly rule, established liberal republic, due to radical reforms and personal charm was assassinated, became Ecuadorian freedom symbol.
reason_zh: 阿尔法罗代表拉丁美洲军事独裁者如何推动世俗化、现代化和民族解放，如何通过铁路和教育改革推动国家发展，以及政治暗杀如何影响国家走向，体现了19世纪末拉美的变革。
reason_en: Alfaro represents how Latin American military dictators promote secularization, modernization and national liberation, how railway and education reforms drive national development, and how political assassination influences national destiny, embodies late 19th century Latin American changes.
steps_zh: 研究阿尔法罗早年军旅生涯/革命意识形成/民族解放思想
分析1895 年上台/激进改革/世俗化教育
探讨铁路建设/国家基础设施/现代经济
评估暗杀事件/政治危机/国家走向
总结自由主义遗产/厄瓜多尔现代国家/阿尔法罗主义
steps_en: Study Alfaro early military career/revolutionary consciousness formation/national liberation idea

expected_en: Understand how Latin American military dictators promote secularization, modernization and national liberation, how railway and education reforms drive national development, and how political assassination influences national destiny.

case_en: 1895 Accession; 1895 Reforms; 1895 Assassination. Secularization/Railway construction/Education reform/Ecuador liberalism endures.
